## Summary

Describe the public-safe problem, the chosen change, and the affected Maker,
Taker, operator, or recovery journey.

## Verification

- [ ] `./scripts/verify-public-repository.sh`
- [ ] `./scripts/run-public-offline-e2e.sh`, or an explanation of why it is not relevant
- [ ] Relevant source formatting, Clippy, unit, and integration checks
- [ ] No credential, private evidence, customer data, internal hostname, or private ticket detail is included
- [ ] Dependencies, copied material, media, generated content, and AI-assisted content have licence/provenance review where applicable
- [ ] Documentation, ADRs, release manifest, and checksums are updated together where applicable
- [ ] Every commit carries a matching `Signed-off-by` line (DCO 1.1)

Security-sensitive details belong in a private vulnerability report, not this
pull request.
